purpose: State-local Easy Install orchestration.  It deliberately does not make a provider or mobile platform support claim.

targets.login_instruction: Run claude in the intended project and complete the browser login.
targets.first_task_instruction: After sign-in, approve the fixed nonce-bound Claude Code proof task; no manual evidence or custom command is accepted.
recovery: claude doctor
re-run easy-resume with the absolute agent executable

targets.login_instruction: Run codex in the intended project and choose a supported sign-in method.
targets.first_task_instruction: After sign-in, approve the fixed nonce-bound Codex proof task; no manual evidence or custom command is accepted.
recovery: Re-run the official installer manually
re-run easy-resume with the absolute agent executable

targets.login_instruction: Run prime-agent and use /login to select an allowed provider or subscription.
targets.first_task_instruction: After sign-in, approve the fixed nonce-bound Prime Agent proof task; no manual evidence or custom command is accepted.
recovery: prime-agent doctor
prime-agent status
re-run easy-resume with the absolute agent executable

targets.manual_install: Inside the same-device Ubuntu guest: curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash
targets.login_instruction: Inside the guest, run claude and complete the browser/device login without recording credentials in Agent Welcome.
targets.first_task_instruction: After guest sign-in, approve the fixed nonce-bound Claude Code proof task; no manual evidence or custom command is accepted.
recovery: Termux Android 12+ may stop background processes; reopen the same guest and run easy-resume
claude doctor

targets.manual_install: Inside the same-device Ubuntu guest: curl -fsSL https://chatgpt.com/codex/install.sh | sh
targets.login_instruction: Inside the guest, run codex and choose a supported sign-in method.
targets.first_task_instruction: After guest sign-in, approve the fixed nonce-bound Codex proof task; no manual evidence or custom command is accepted.
recovery: Termux Android 12+ may stop background processes; reopen the same guest and run easy-resume
Re-run the official installer manually

targets.manual_install: Inside the same-device Ubuntu 24.04 glibc guest: curl -fsSL https://app.primeintellect.ai/prime-agent/install.sh | sh
targets.login_instruction: Inside the guest, run prime-agent and use /login without recording credentials in Agent Welcome.
targets.first_task_instruction: After guest sign-in, approve the fixed nonce-bound Prime Agent proof task; no manual evidence or custom command is accepted.
recovery: Use a glibc >= 2.35 guest; musl is not a supported Prime release target
prime-agent doctor
reopen after Android process kill and run easy-resume

targets.first_task_instruction: After guest sign-in, approve the fixed nonce-bound Claude Code proof task; no manual evidence or custom command is accepted.
recovery: Install/open UTM and import/boot the Linux guest before resuming
